integrity: All dimension equalities are derived from the cited construction, its ordinary-dimension and prime-chain statements, quotient-field transcendence degree, and standard valuative-dimension bounds. No numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The exact profile is proved for the explicit Tran–Nguyen realization domains with \(3\le m\le n\); the coefficient-transform statement is for the base family. No classification of valuation overrings or claim about all domains with the same ordinary dimension pair is made.
title: Exact Jaffard profile of the Tran–Nguyen realization domains
